topic: NGINX check fails with 403 after hardening
symptom_pattern: The nginx check started failing with 403 Forbidden after the security team applied a hardened nginx.conf; the site itself works.
root_cause: The stub_status location now only allows 127.0.0.1, so requests from the Agent (another container/IP) are denied.
resolution_path: Read the check error in agent status
Look at the allow/deny rules on the status location
Allow the Agent's network/IP or serve status on an internal-only port

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you share the location block for the status endpoint?
Does curl to the status URL from inside the Agent container work?

customer_style.tone: professional, security-conscious, wants to keep things locked down
